preset.description: CMake preset whose build dir contains the binary

binary.description: Path to the executable or .app bundle, relative to build/<preset>/

simulator.description: If set, install and launch the .app on an iOS or tvOS simulator via simctl

bundleId.description: CFBundleIdentifier of the app (required when simulator is set)

device.description: Optional simulator name substring (e.g. iPhone 17, Apple TV)
